subject: Spatial CAR model with varying precision parameters

messages.author: 84799cd2e00b1b8d
messages.subject: Spatial CAR model with varying precision parameters
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to construct a CAR model, which would have its own precision parameter for each area. 
At first i tried to use the "group"-option, however i think i'm misinterpreting the use of "group" as it didn't give the expected results.

This is the code i used so far....

        region.struct2 = region.struct

formula= y ~ f(region.unstruct,model="iid", param=c(0.5,0.008)) + 
f(region.struct,model="besag", graph=graph.loc,param=c(0.5,0.008), adjust.for.con.comp = FALSE, group = region.struct2)

mod <- inla(formula, family = "binomial", data = data, 
Ntrials=samplesize, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,link=1), control.compute=list(dic=TRUE))

Any tips on how to proceed? 
Thanks in advance!

Kind regards,
K

messages.subject: Re: Spatial CAR model with varying precision parameters
parts:
That would not be feasible as the number og hyperparametrs will be high.

If you have 3 day areas, fex you can use one such model for each, to get three different precision’s
